chunks: From him, from Usman ibn Isa, from Sama'ah who said:
I asked him about a hunting dog being kept in the house. He said: If a door can be closed on it, then there is no problem.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to keep a hunting dog inside the house according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Samaanah ibn Mihar asks Imam al-Sadiq (AS) about the permissibility of keeping a hunting dog indoors. The Imam clarifies that it is permissible (*la ba'sa*) provided the dog is confined behind a door, thereby preventing it from roaming freely and defiling the living space. This ruling reflects the Shia juristic principle of balancing the utility of hunting dogs with the preservation of ritual purity (*taharah*) within the home.
